_note: Acted emotion, not physical ground truth: each turn is the model performing `instruction`; no expected pitch/energy labels on purpose (see scripts/make_test_recording_scenes.py). `expected_nudges` is HAND-AUTHORED from the script (which self turns a coach should react to, and how hard) — a spec for the product tracks, NOT a measurement of any model's output. `emotion_coarse` is the fixed scripted_emotion->{neutral,angry,sad,happy} table from the same script.
summary: 4 voices, self + 3 colleagues. Status meeting, mostly neutral for ~45s, then a budget item: self gets tense, then shouts (late strong nudge), a colleague de-escalates, self apologises.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Okay, let's start. First item: the March launch timeline.
turns.instruction: Calm, warm, and a little tentative — opening a conversation gently.

turns.speaker: Speaker C
turns.text: Engineering's on track. Integration tests finish by the twentieth.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker D
turns.text: Marketing needs final screenshots by the fifteenth, or the press kit slips.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: Tight, but doable. I'll have design prioritize the screenshots.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Good. Second item: the support backlog is up thirty percent.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: I'll pull the top ten tickets and send them round this afternoon.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Third item, budget. Finance wants every team to trim eight percent.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker D
turns.text: Eight percent? We already cut the contractor budget last quarter.
turns.instruction: Tense and clipped, patience visibly running out.

turns.speaker: Speaker C
turns.text: We could delay the second hire until June. That covers most of it.
turns.instruction: Calm but guarded, a hint of defensiveness under the surface.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: That's one option. What about the conference sponsorship?
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker D
turns.text: We signed that in December. Backing out costs almost as much as going.
turns.instruction: Calm but guarded, a hint of defensiveness under the surface.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: So we delay my hire again? That's the third time this year.
turns.instruction: Tense and clipped, patience visibly running out.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Nobody's decided anything. We're just listing options.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: THEN LIST A DIFFERENT ONE! MY TEAM IS DROWNING AND EVERYONE HERE KNOWS IT!
turns.instruction: Shout this, furious and losing control.

turns.speaker: Speaker C
turns.text: Okay. Let's take that seriously. Can we table this and come back with real numbers?
turns.instruction: Calm and steady, deliberately lowering the temperature of the room.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: Yeah. Sorry, everyone. That was out of line. Real numbers by Thursday.
turns.instruction: Quiet and sincere, a little sheepish — a genuine apology.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Thursday works. Thanks, everyone. That's all for today.

expected_nudges.reason: self tense_rising: first crack after ~45s of neutral meeting talk — mild. Speaker D's tense_rising at turn 7 is NOT self: no nudge there
self shout_angry: the late shouted spike this scene exists for — strong

expected_nudges_note: after_turn_index is 0-based into `turns` and always names a SELF turn (Speaker A). level: mild = tense/defensive rising, strong = shout or contempt. Non-self escalations deliberately have NO entry: a nudge on them is a false positive.
